description: What changed in sevDesk since a point in time (sevDesk has no webhooks): contacts, invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften), orders (Angebote/Aufträge), vouchers (Belege) and bank transactions (Umsätze) last updated at or after since, as compact rows (id, type, number/name, status, update time, link) with per-subject counts. Use it to sync or review recent changes instead of paging every list; details via the get tools. Up to limit rows per subject; to page on, pass one subject with offset = nextOffset. Credit notes and transactions have no sevDesk change filter and are checked here (up to 5,000 rows per call). Deleted records do not appear.

limit.description: Changed records to return per subject, 1–100.

offset.description: sevDesk rows to skip (a previous nextOffset); only with exactly one subject.

since.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (00:00 Berlin) or an ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-01T08:00:00+01:00 (Berlin time without an offset).

subjects.description: Which records to check; default all.

name: sevdesk_changed_since
title: Changes since
